name: Kuraki Azusa
source:
Daughter of Ryouko. An university student that wants to get a job fast to help with her father debt. 
She gets along well with her cousin Manami.
[spoiler]When she noticed that her mother became Shinji's toy, she volunteered to become one herself to save her.[/spoiler]
translation:
Daughter of Ryouko. An university student that wants to get a job fast to help with her father debt. 
She gets along well with her cousin Manami.
[spoiler]When she noticed that her mother became Shinji's toy, she volunteered to become one herself to save her.[/spoiler]
